summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour delivers a lecture on a hadith from the book of knowledge discussing how no believer will be satisfied until they reach paradise. He explains how Allah's commands work in harmony with human nature rather than against it, using the concept of redirecting natural human drives and inclinations toward productive ends. Sh. Ali Mashhour emphasizes that Islam harnesses human nature through proper channels—such as knowledge, jihad, marriage, and worship—rather than suppressing it, and warns against attempting to unnaturally dam up natural human forces, as this leads to destructive outcomes. He addresses modern misconceptions about gender roles and fulfillment, arguing that trying to change Allah's design of human nature will ultimately backfire.
